about: Stills for the 'One morning' direction (fresh round, 2026-11-01): one fictional student, Nora, through one school Thursday in January, from waking to a live class on Zoom that evening. One grade across every still. Built by scripts/generate-assets.mjs with --manifest assets/fresh/morning.manifest.json --state assets/fresh/morning.state.json --out .impeccable/mocks/fresh/morning/raw.

defaults.suffix: Photoreal, documentary, natural light, soft contrast, true colour, fine film grain. One continuous shot, slow and physical camera move, no cuts. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, lens flare, bokeh circles, light orbs, purple, glowing orbs or rockets. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera.
defaults.stillSuffix: A frame from a quiet 35mm feature film, wide 16:9 cinematic composition with the person near the centre of the frame. Graded on Kodak Vision3 500T: cool slate-blue shadows, warm amber light from lamps and low sun, muted saturation, soft highlight roll-off, lifted blacks, fine film grain, gentle halation. True skin texture with pores and fine detail, natural hands with five fingers. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including on clothing, signs and devices. Phone and laptop screens face away from the camera and are never visible. No paper, notebooks, pencils or calculators. No purple, neon or lens flare.

Nora, a 17-year-old girl with dark brown hair in a loose low ponytail, warm light-brown skin and a few freckles, wearing an oversized forest-green knit sweater, sits cross-legged on her unmade bed beside a tall window. Outside the window the sky is deep blue before sunrise, a bare tree and the roofs of a quiet street. A small bedside lamp gives warm amber light. She holds her phone in both hands, its back to the camera, and looks down at it, calm and focused, a small private concentration. White AirPods Pro in her ears. Medium-wide shot at eye level, 35mm lens, room for type on the left third of the frame.
